title: VOLVO FE FUPS Custom built aero Bullbar #23
description: Bullbar for FE Volvo. Reinforcing grill over headlights, 88mm diameter pipe. We build our bars tough as this one shows being extra heavy duty. Main cross tubes are one piece 88 mm heavy wall diameter pipe passing through the drilled uprights and recessed into the outer uprights, no but welds. Steel tow pin mounted in heavy duty steel backing plate. Front mudflap provision.
